name: Stamped.io
description: Stamped.io is an ecommerce retention platform for product and company reviews, ratings, questions, surveys, visual content, loyalty, referrals, and review-request automation.
agentUseSummary: Stamped.io cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its private REST API requires a Professional or Enterprise customer's Store Hash plus static public/private keys over HTTP Basic Auth, with no published granular permission or delegated OAuth contract; representative credential and entitlement acceptance is required first.

credentialRequirements.label: Stamped Store Hash
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer store identifier from the Stamped API Keys page.

credentialRequirements.name: STAMPED_PUBLIC_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Stamped public API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Static Basic Auth username stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

credentialRequirements.name: STAMPED_PRIVATE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Stamped private API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Static Basic Auth password stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

blocked.label: Collect Stamped credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect static private keys before representative paid-account acceptance.

blocked.label: Substitute public endpoints
blocked.description: Storefront widgets and public-key reads do not establish private account ownership or lifecycle semantics.

blocked.label: Access Stamped data
blocked.description: Reviews, questions, surveys, products, customers, orders, loyalty, referrals, and account data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate or use raw Stamped APIs
blocked.description: Review/invitation imports, moderation, replies, survey bulk operations, loyalty changes, arbitrary endpoints, and broad pagination are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Stamped.io action is enabled before customer credential and entitlement acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Stamped.io wrappers are mounted until a representative paid-account key establishes the frozen contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Stamped API access requires a Professional or Enterprise customer to retrieve its Store Hash and static public/private API keys. Private endpoints use unscoped Basic Auth, while public documentation does not establish key rotation/revocation, exact plan entitlements, regional behavior, or a representative operation contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative paid customer, provision dedicated keys without exposing them in reports, record enabled products and rotation/revocation behavior, inspect exact schemas and quotas without external writes, and return the frozen authority contract before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: Stamped documents Professional/Enterprise API access, Store Hash routing, customer public/private keys, HTTP Basic Auth for private endpoints, and public endpoints requiring only Store Hash or public key.
Stamped publishes a broad v2 REST surface including private dashboard reviews and survey/review bulk operations under static account credentials.
Stamped states API keys are managed in the account Control Panel rather than through delegated OAuth or granular per-install scopes.
